mapper.select: SELECT s.user_id,s.csrf_token,u.email,u.display_name,ds.device_id AS current_device_id FROM sessions s JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id LEFT JOIN auth_device_sessions ds ON ds.token_hash=s.token_hash WHERE s.token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND s.expires_at>#{now}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sessions WHERE token_hash IN (SELECT token_hash FROM auth_device_sessions WHERE device_id=#{deviceId})
